title: Eifion the Hat Appreciator
markdown:
Once upon a time, in a sunny meadow, Eifion the donkey opened his hat-check stall. “Welcome to the fair,” he brayed, ready to help.

The fair was full of bouncy balloons and happy music. Smells of sweet candy floss tickled Eifion’s nose. People bustled by, eyes wide with wonder. Eifion waited, his hooves tapping.

But then Eifion saw something funny. People took off hats to look at other hats. No one checked hats with him. Eifion’s ears drooped. He felt a little sad.

His friends arrived: Nora the koala, Tilly the kitten, and Captain Wren. They saw Eifion wasn’t smiling. “Nobody’s checking hats,” Eifion mumbled.

Captain Wren chirped, “Maybe it’s a hat show. They’ll check them after.” Nora smiled. “Why not look at the hats, Eifion? You notice pretty things.” Tilly purred, “You can tell them their hats look super.”

Eifion’s face crinkled into a big smile. “I know. I’ll be Eifion, the Hat Appreciator.”

From then on, when people took off hats, Eifion called out, “What a colourful hat,” or “That’s a splendid hat.” He even helped Tilly try on a floppy hat that slipped over one ear and made Captain Wren laugh a bright little laugh.

Soon people chuckled and smiled at Eifion’s cheerful words. They started bringing him hats to check, happy to share the fun and hear his kind compliments. Eifion’s stall became the happiest place, full of smiles, and the candy-floss air smelled even sweeter when a hat had been properly admired.

A hat likes a kind word almost as much as a hook. What other fair stall, do you suppose, is waiting for someone to notice it properly?
characters: Eifion (fair hat-check donkey), Nora (kind koala friend), Tilly (floppy-hat kitten)
author: StoryGen Community
